hero_subtitle: Atlantic sand and swell a short ride from Safi.

overview.title: Beach time on the Atlantic
overview.p1: Lalla Fatna is one of the main beach options near Safi: open sand, Atlantic waves and a more spacious feel than the city waterfront.
overview.p2: Conditions depend on wind and swell. Swimming is for confident swimmers when the sea is calm; otherwise it is a place for walking and air.
overview.p3: Bring sun protection, water and a plan for transport back to town.

2.title: Strong sun
2.desc: Shade is limited; protect skin and hydrate.

3.title: Golden shore
3.desc: Pleasant for a walk if wind allows.

food.title: Food near Lalla Fatna
food.p1: Facilities vary by season. Do not rely on a full restaurant strip.
food.li3: Proper meal back in Safi (port or medina).
food.li5: Cash if any stall is open.
food.p2: Treat the beach as a nature stop, not a full-service resort.

1.title: Respect the sea
1.desc: Atlantic currents can be strong. Swim only when conditions are clearly safe.

2.title: Sun and wind
2.desc: Little natural shade. Hat, sunscreen and water are essential.

3.title: Transport
3.desc: Agree taxi fares or arrange return before you settle on the sand.

q1.question: How far from Safi centre?
q1.answer: A short drive or taxi ride along the coast — confirm time with your driver.

q2.question: Is swimming safe?
q2.answer: Only when the sea is calm and you are a confident swimmer. Conditions change with wind and swell.

q3.question: Are there facilities?
q3.answer: Limited and seasonal. Bring what you need.

q4.question: Best time of year?
q4.answer: Late spring to early autumn for beach weather; always check wind.

q5.question: Can I go with children?
q5.answer: Yes for sand play; supervise closely near the water.
